challenge.method: Read the interface grammar on page 33 and module redeclaration rules on page 34. Tested whether an exporting module must implement every declaration or exactly duplicate the interface signature.
challenge.results: The module can provide a body for a declared procedure, with the implementation signature covered by the interface signature. The 1989 source describes provision of one or more bodies by an exporting module.

limitations: This supports the documented declaration boundary. Linker, binary, and cross-implementation behavior were outside the claim.
